note: Everyday things a posed figure holds, carries or looks at. Handheld objects use place=float in their natural upright orientation; sizes are frame fill, not real size. Phones, bags and cups are the classic places where a model adds a brand shape or printing, so every one of those carries an explicit negative. Hats and bags worn on the body are in the costume library (AC); the kraft shopping bag here is a disposable paper bag, not a fashion bag.
